Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes will open the batting for Australia Women. Jhulan Goswami will begin proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Australia Women have a tough ask ahead of them but we all know their potential with the bat. They need to chase down a record-breaking target of 278 runs and it promises to be an interesting second-half of the game. Do join us for the chase which begins shortly.

Yastika Bhatia is down for a chat. She says that two wickets had fallen, and she had to steady the innings along with Mithali Raj, they had to make sure no more wickets fell. Mentions that she did bat at number 3 in the previous series and has been batting at number 3 in the domestic circuit as well, and she was well prepared to bat at that position today. States that Darcie Brown bowled well, the spinners also bowled well. But due to windy conditions, they missed their line at times. Concludes by saying that it will be a close game and they have a defendable target.

Not the best of bowling efforts from Australia Women as they were wayward with their lines and lengths for a majority of the innings. Although, it was Darcie Brown who struck early as she knocked off both the openers cheaply and finished as the standout bowler for Australia. The other bowlers though found it hard to find their lines and lengths and the Aussie bowlers gave away 24 runs in only wides. Alana King, the leggie picked up a couple of wickets but she too leaked runs at one point.

India Women didn't get off to a great start as they lost both their openers early on in the innings. Although, it was the pair of Yastika Bhatia and skipper Mithali Raj that steadied the ship for them and they stitched together a crucial stand of 130 runs for the third wicket. However, both these batters failed to convert their fifties into a big one and India Women found themselves in a spot of bother at 213/6. It was Harmanpreet Kaur's unbeaten knock of 57 runs that kept India in the contest and overall, it has been a good effort from their batting department, considering they were bundled out for just 134 in their previous game.

A much-needed impetus in the end by Harmanpreet Kaur and Pooja Vastrakar has made sure that India Women post a good total on the board against the mighty Aussies. A partnership of 64 runs off just 47 balls from Kaur and Vastrakar proved to be frustrating for Meg Lanning and her troops as they were not up to the mark with the ball right throughout the innings. A total of 29 extras were conceded by the bowlers and that tells us the entire story.

OUT! RUN OUT! A wicket on the last delivery of the innings, but a good finish this for India Women! Jess Jonassen serves a very full ball again, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it back to the bowler. Pooja Vastrakar sees Harmanpreet Kaur leaving her crease for a single and she goes across as well. Jess Jonassen collects the ball and whips the bails off at the non-striker's end. Pooja Vastrakar sacrifices her wicket in the end. India Women finish at 277/7!
Tosses it up, full again, around leg. Pooja Vastrakar dances down the and whips it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full now, loopy delivery. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards long off for a single.
Slower through the air, fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur steps down and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller ball again, down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards fine leg. Two taken!
Slower through the air, very full, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar advances down the track and drills it down to long off for a single.
Another ball, on a length, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar drags it towards long on and takes a single.
SIX! BANG! Take that, says Pooja Vastrakar! A length ball, around middle. Pooja sits back and whacks it way over long on for a maximum.
Slower ball, shorter again, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar looks to pull this but she misses.
Tad shorter, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar slaps it over cover for two runs!

Leg bye! NOT OUT! A length ball, angling in, down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to heaves this over the leg side but she misses. The ball brushes off her front pad and goes towards fine leg. Australia Women appeal for LBW, but it's turned down. They opt for a review! No bat confirms UlraEdge. Ball Tracker shows it was sliding down leg. The on-field decision stands. The batters also sneak in a leg bye!

Review! Australia Women opt for a review as Harmanpreet Kaur has been struck on her pad. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it suggests that the ball would have missed the leg stump. Australia Women lose another review.
Full, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur drills it down to long off. Ellyse Perry fumbles a bit, but she keeps the ball away from the ropes. Two taken!
FIFTY for Harmanpreet Kaur! A full toss from Jess, around middle. Kaur helps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar skips down and mistimes her heave towards long on for a single.
Full toss now, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it towards long off for a single.
Tosses it up, very full, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar steps down and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Full again, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Pooja Vastrakar looks to sweep this but she misses. The ball goes off her pads towards third man. Leg bye taken!
Jess Jonassen (5-0-27-1) comes back to bowl.
Slower ball, short again, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar eases it down to long on for a single.
Full toss now, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards long on for a single. That brings up 250 for India!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Perfect placement! A shorter ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur swivels and pulls it between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length, around middle, angling in. Pooja Vastrakar works it towards mid on for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar walks across and works it away towards mid-wicket for a single. 17 runs off the over!
FOUR! Another boundary in the over! Pooja Vastrakar is on the charge. A fuller ball, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar stays in her crease and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.

Wide! Another loopy ball, a leg-spinner, wide of off. Pooja Vastrakar once again looks to smash this over on the off side this time but she misses. Alyssa Healy collects the ball and whips the bails off. The third umpire checks for stumping, but Pooja Vastrakar is well in! Wide called!
Stumping-check! Alyssa Healy behind the sticks has whipped the bails off and Pooja Vastrakar might be in trouble. The replays roll in and it shows that Pooja had her back foot grounded.
Loopy ball, outside off, spinning away, full in length. Pooja Vastrakar looks to heaves this, but she misses.
SIX! BANG! Good runs these for India Women! Tad fuller, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar steps down and smashes it over long off for a biggie!
Full again, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Hammered! Slower through the air, very full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the pitch and drills it down the ground. Beth Mooney from long on fails to stop the ball, and the ball goes past the ropes for a boundary!
Short of a length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar hangs back and punches it to the cover fielder. A dot to end the over!
Excellent running, yet again! Back of a length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur taps it to backward point and sets off for a quick single.
Schutt goes full and outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it wide of long off and manages only a single this time.
Good running between the wickets! Good-length ball, around middle. Pooja taps it through the vacant mid-wicket region and comes back for the second run.
On a length, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur backs away and drags it to long on for a run.
This is a length ball, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar nudges it through mid-wicket and collects a single.
Megan Schutt (7-0-31-0) is brought back into the attack.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar cuts it to deep cover for a run.
A loopy ball, well outside off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it to the cover fielder.
Fuller in length, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar tucks it to mid-wicket.
A short ball, around off. Pooja Vastrakar punches it back to the bowler.

PUT DOWN! Massive moment in the game! Floated, full and around off. Kaur looks to slog-sweep but it goes off the top edge, in the air and wide of the long on fielder. Beth Mooney runs in from long on and dives to her right to take the catch but she puts it down. The batters take a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur miscues her sweep wide of deep mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Looped up, on a length, around leg. Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg and takes a run. She retains the strike.
A low full toss, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur drills it straight back to the bowler.
Full and around middle. Pooja Vastrakar eases it to long on and takes a single to get off the mark.
Floated, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar defends it with ease.
Tossed up, around middle. Pooja Vastrakar keeps it out.
Pooja Vastrakar comes to the crease now.

OUT! TIMBER! Right through the gate! Jess Jonassen strikes straightaway and India Women are losing their way here! Jess serves a length ball, she gets some drift and the ball lands around middle. Sneh Rana plays inside the line of the ball and looks to drive on the up. The ball straightens and sneaks through her bat and pad to cannon onto her middle stump.
Jess Jonassen (4-0-25-0) comes back into the attack.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it to the backward point fielder.

Leg bye! An appeal for LBW but turned down! This is a full ball, spinning down leg. Sneh Rana looks to sweep but she misses. The ball rolls away to the leg side after hitting her pads and the batters sneak in a leg bye. That was sliding definitely down leg!
Full and outside off. Sneh Rana drives it to the cover fielder.
Floated, full and outside off. Sneh Rana blocks it towards cover.
Tossed up around off. Sneh Rana keeps it out.
Sneh Rana walks out to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! Australia Women continue to take wickets! Clever bowling from Alana King! She sees Ghosh stepping down the track to slog so she drags her length back and serves it wider, outside off. Ghosh misses her heave as the ball spins past her blade. Alyssa Healy behind the sticks collects the ball and whips the bails off. India Women lose half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Alana King

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! SMASHED! Fuller in length, on middle. Kaur gets down on her knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
An overpitched ball, on middle and leg. Richa Ghosh glances it to fine leg and settles for a single this time.
A full ball, around middle. Richa Ghosh drags it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Full and outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it towards mid off.
A length ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur guides it to long on and takes a single.
FOUR! A low full toss, around leg. Kaur sits back and just helps it on its way through fine leg for a boundary.
End of Powerplay 2! Australia Women can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Richa Ghosh hangs back and pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Cheeky shot! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Richa Ghosh gets down on her knee and scoops it towards fine leg. Jess Jonassen chases it down and keeps it away from the boundary ropes. Two taken!
Shorter now, spinning away, outside off. Richa Ghosh punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Very full now, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Another loopy delivery, very full again, on middle. Richa Ghosh drills it down to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery, very full, around middle. Richa Ghosh pushes it towards cover.
Another length delivery, outside off. Richa Ghosh pushes it towards point for a single.
Length, around middle. Richa Ghosh works it away towards mid-wicket.

Mix-up...but no harm done! On a length, outside off. Richa Ghosh pokes it towards third man and runs across. Harmanpreet Kaur sends her back, and Richa Ghosh dives in to make her ground. Direct-hit would have probably done the trick here for Australia Women!
On a length, wide of off. Richa Ghosh looks to cut this one away, but she misses.

NOT OUT! Fuller ball, angling in, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and looks to sweep this away, but she gets a slight glove on it towards fine leg. Australia Women appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! They opt for a review and the UltraEdge confirms that there was glove on it. The on-field decision stands. Australia Women lose a review. A single taken as well!

Review! Australia Women opt for a review as they feel Harmanpreet Kaur has been struck on her pad. Was there any bat involved in it? The UltraEdge rolls in and it shows that the ball hit Harmanpreet Kaur's glove.
Good running! On a length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur works it away towards square leg for a brace.
Pitches it up again, slower through the air, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards square leg for a single. She retains the strike!
FOUR! Nicely done! This is tossed up, around middle. Kaur kneels and paddles it fine through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full again, around middle. Richa Ghosh nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single. She gets off the mark with that.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Alana King strikes and gets rid of Mithali Raj now. Another set batter is gone. A good knock by the Indian skipper comes to an end! A fuller ball, around middle, slower through the air. Mithali Raj gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. Ellyse Perry there takes another fine catch. India Women lose their fourth wicket now and the Aussies are ecstatic.
Commentary.Howout: c Ellyse Perry b Alana King

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Slower through the air, loopy ball, full. Harmanpreet Kaur steps down and pushes it towards mid on.
On a length, outside off. Mithali Raj defends it out.
Fuller now, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and scoops this towards fine leg for a single.
Length, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Mithali Raj stays back and tries to cut this, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Single taken!
Very full now, down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur clips it fine towards fine leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Mithali Raj nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off, spinning away. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to cut this away, but she misses.

In the air...and just short! A shorter ball again, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur stays in her crease and looks to tuck this away, but the ball goes off the leading edge towards the bowler and falls just short of her.
Shorter, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Perfect execution! Slower through the air, very full, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tad quicker, outside off, full in length. Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back and looks to cut this away, but she misses.
A loopy ball, full, around middle. Mithali Raj miscues her sweep shot towards short fine leg for a single.
Alana King (4-0-15-0) comes back to bowl.
A slower bumper, around middle. Mithali Raj swivels and pulls it along the ground towards fine leg for a single.
A short ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur is quick to rock back as she pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur taps it to backward point.
This is on a length, outside off. Mithali Raj steers it to third man for a run.
Good-length delivery, around off. Mithali Raj blocks it with ease.
Back of a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it in front of square towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! WHACKED! A full ball, on the pads. Mithali Raj sits back and whips it through the backward square leg region to bag a boundary. Lovely timing and even better placement from Mithali!
Banged in short, around off. Mithali Raj gets on top of the bounce and keeps it out.
On a length, around leg. Harmanpreet Kaur tickles it to fine leg for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to drive but she misses.
Harmanpreet Kaur has been struck on the helmet. The physio is out there for the mandatory concussion test. She seems fine, and we are good to go!
A short ball, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur looks to pull but she misses. She gets hit on her shoulder and then on her helmet.
Full and on middle. Mithali Raj drills it to mid on for a single.
Another ball, short and around leg. Mithali Raj pulls it to fine leg and takes a single.
A short ball from Perry, just outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back and looks to ramp it over the keeper but fails to get any bat on it.
Back of a length, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur swivels and pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off. Mithali Raj drives it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
This is a length ball, around leg. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it to deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a run.
On a length, around off. Kaur blocks it.
Ellyse Perry comes back into the attack. She went for 16 runs in her first over.
A well-directed bumper, around leg. Mithali Raj glances it past the keeper through fine leg. Megan Schutt runs across from fine leg and keeps it to two by sliding to her right.
A full ball, around middle. Mithali Raj flicks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.

DRINKS! Australia Women have got the much-needed breakthrough. India Women were cruising along nicely, but Yastika Bhatia could not hold on. They are still in a very good position, and they will want to carry on till the end and put up a big score. While Australia Women will not want another big partnership here and they will be keen to take wickets. Harmanpreet Kaur comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Yastika Bhatia looks to up the ante but holes out. It is Darcie Brown who does the job for her side yet again! A much-needed breakthrough for the Aussies as this partnership was looking ominous for them. Brown goes full and outside off. Bhatia looks to free her arms on the off side but ends up slicing it straight down the throat of Ellyse Perry at deep cover who makes no mistake. Just the one fielder in the deep on the off side and Bhatia hits it straight to that fielder. India Women lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Ellyse Perry b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: A bumper, around leg. Yastika Bhatia ducks underneath.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mithali Raj throws her bat at it. It goes off the outside edge and behind square on the off side for a run.
On a length, around off. Mithali Raj keeps it out.

FOUR! Deft touch! This is excellent batting from Bhatia! She played that so late! A quicker ball, going on with the arm, from middle. Yastika Bhatia stays back and just guides it through the third man region for a boundary.
A flatter ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards deep cover where the fielder fumbles and the batters take two runs.
Tossed up, around off. Yastika Bhatia prods and keeps it out.
Floated, around middle. Yastika Bhatia sweeps it fine towards the short fine leg fielder.
FOUR! FIFTY for Yastika Bhatia! This is a shorter-length delivery, outside off. Bhatia hangs back and cuts it past the short third man fielder for a boundary. Top innings from the southpaw!
Wide! Another ball that is darted down leg. The umpire calls it as a wide yet again.
Wide! A wayward ball, down leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her whip on the leg side and the umpire signals wide.
Yastika Bhatia has been hit on the helmet by the fielder. The physio is out there to check on her. A mandatory concussion test will be done. We are good to resume!

This is tossed up, outside off. Mithali Raj defends it towards cover and sets off for a single. The fielder at cover has a shy at the striker's end but the ball hits Yastika Bhatia's helmet as she dives to get inside the crease.
Shorter ball now, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia ducks under it and leaves it alone.

This one lands on a length, around the pads. Mithali Raj tucks it towards fine leg for a single. That brings up her 50! What an innings this has been from her. Mithali Raj has stepped up when her team needed it the most.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Mithali Raj defends it out.
Wide of off, on a length. Yastika Bhatia slaps this and finds the fielder at deep cover. Single taken!
On a length now, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover. No run there!
Tad fuller, outside off. Mithali Raj leans and drives it towards sweeper cover for single.
Darcie Brown (5-0-16-2) is back on.
Fuller, down the leg side. Yastika Bhatia miscues her sweep shot towards short fine leg.
Tad shorter, spinning this away, around off. Mithali Raj pushes it towards point for a single. This is now the highest third-wicket partnership for India Women against Australia Women in ODIs.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Yastika Bhatia knocks it down to long on for a single.
Full again, around middle. Yastika Bhatia miscues her shot back to the bowler. She bumps into Mithali Raj while stopping the ball.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Yastika Bhatia lunges and pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Great use of the feet by Yastika Bhatia! Loopy ball, full, around middle. Yastika Bhatia dances down the track and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mithali Raj defends it towards cover.
SIX! BOOM! Top shot from the Indian skipper! A fuller ball, around off. Mithali Raj shimmies down the pitch and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie!
Shorter ball, turning in, around middle. Mithali Raj pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery, full, on middle. Yastika Bhatia sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tad fuller, around middle. Mithali Raj pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. 100-run stand comes up between these two!
Fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia shuffles across and swipes it towards fine leg for a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it down to long on for a single.
Full again, around middle. Yastika Bhatia works it away towards mid-wicket.
Very full this time, slower through the air, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards cover.
Shorter again, around middle. Yastika Bhatia nudges it to mid-wicket.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Mithali Raj dabs it towards third man and rotates the strike!
Tosses it up, very full, around middle. Yastika Bhatia drills it down to long on for a single.
Wide of off, on a length. Yastika Bhatia cuts it towards the diving fielder at point. Single taken!
Fuller delivery, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it past cover for a single.
Two Wides! Down the leg side, on a length. Yastika Bhatia leaves it alone. Alyssa Healy fumbles and the batters sneak in a run.
Shorter now, outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back, opens the face of her bat, and guides it towards third man. Single taken!
Touch fuller, outside off. Mithali Raj knocks it towards mid off.
Tad fuller, wide of off. Mithali Raj drives it uppishly over the fielder at cover-point. Two taken!
On a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia taps it towards point for a single.
A flatter ball, spinning in from middle. Yastika Bhatia wrists it to mid-wicket and settles for a run. She retains the strike.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mithali Raj prods and pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Good change of pace from King! This is a quicker ball, on a length, around off. Mithali Raj hangs back and cuts it towards cover-point.
This is floated, full and just outside off. Mithali Raj gets forward and defends it.
Tossed up delivery, around off. Mithali Raj blocks it with ease.
Floated, on a length, outside off. Mithali Raj stays back and taps it towards point.
FOUR! Top shot from the southpaw! An overpitched ball, on middle. Yastika Bhatia prods and drills it along the ground, back past the bowler to bag a boundary.
A slight mix-up but no harm done! Good-length delivery, around leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it to mid-wicket and looks for a single but her skipper wisely sends her back in time.
On a length, around middle. Mithali Raj works it towards deep cover and collects a single.
Width on offer, outside off. Mithali Raj looks to slash hard but it goes off the outer half of the blade behind square on the off side. The batters take two runs.
Good-length delivery, around off. Mithali Raj blocks it off the front foot.
A length ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia works it through covers and hands the strike back to her skipper.
Change of ends for Tahlia McGrath (3-0-7-0).
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and nudges it through mid-wicket to take a single.
A quicker ball, on a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out.
Flighted ball, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it to cover where the fielder fumbles and the batters take a single.
Floated, full and outside off. Mithali Raj drives it to mid off.
Around off, blocked out.
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia drills it to long on and settles for a single. Both the batters have now scored 30 off 53 balls.
Wide! King starts with a wayward ball, down leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her pull. Wided!
Alana King comes into the attack now.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Yastika Bhatia cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Gardner tosses this one up, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it past the diving fielder at extra cover and the batters take three runs. 100 comes up for India Women!
Flighted ball, outside off. Mithali Raj prods and keeps it out.
Floated, on middle. Mithali Raj gets forward and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Mithali Raj pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely done! Slightly shorter in length and outside off. Mithali Raj uses the pace of the ball, hangs back and steers it through the third man region to bag a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia taps it towards cover. Three runs off the over!
This is on a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out.
Short of a length, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia shuffles across to whack it through square leg but fails to get any bat on it.
Back of a length, around off. Mithali Raj steers it to third man for a single.
Full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
A full ball, around leg. Mithali Raj whips it behind square on the leg side for a single.

Just over! A fuller ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia shuffles across and looks to scoop this over fine leg, but she misses. The ball bounces and goes just over the middle stump. Yastika Bhatia gets lucky here! Extra bounce might have saved her.
Loopy delivery, full again, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Mithali Raj leans and defends it out.
Fuller ball, around middle. Mithali Raj sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, spinning away, outside off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards deep cover for a single.

TWO BYES! BEATEN! A peach of a delivery! Tosses this one up, fuller, around the leg pole. Yastika Bhatia looks to flick this but she misses, the ball sneaks through the gap between the bat and pad. It lobs up over the leg pole, the keeper fails to grab the ball and goes towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Full again, outside off. Mithali Raj leans and drives it past cover for a brace.
Fullish delivery, around the off pole. Mithali Raj drives it uppishly towards the fielder at cover-point who collects the ball on a bounce.
Angling in, on a length, on the pads. Yastika Bhatia flicks it past square leg for a single.
Tad shorter, outside off again. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards cover.
Outside off now, on a length. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up, around middle, angling in. Yastika Bhatia nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Full, on middle. Mithali Raj blocks it out.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Yastika Bhatia dabs it towards point for a single.
TWO WIDES! Once again down the leg side, fuller ball. Mithali Raj misses her sweep yet again. Alyssa Healy fumbles to grab the ball and the batters sneak in a run.
THREE WIDES! Fuller ball, spinning in, down leg. Mithali Raj looks to sweep but she misses. Alyssa Healy fails to grab the ball as well. The batters take two runs in return! 50-run stand is up!
Turning in, full again, outside off. Mithali Raj leans and defends it out watchfully.
Tad fuller, outside off. Mithali Raj pushes it towards cover-point.
Much fuller now, on middle. Yastika Bhatia drills it down towards mid off for a single.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Yastika Bhatia guides it towards point.
Full again, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it towards cover. Just 1 run off Tahlia McGrath's first over!
Fuller delivery now, around middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
On a length, on middle. Yastika Bhatia presents the full face of her bat and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, width on offer now. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and chops it straight to the fielder at point.
Touch fuller now, on middle. Yastika Bhatia pushes it back to the bowler.
Tahlia McGrath begins with a length ball, on the pads. Yastika Bhatia clips it towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS! India Women have recovered reasonably well after losing two wickets inside first six overs. Australia Women started well with the ball but they have been a bit wayward post that. They will be keen to break this stand and keep the batters on their toes going ahead in this match. Tahlia McGrath comes to bowl now.
Fuller ball again, spinning in, around middle. Mithali Raj defends it out off the front foot. A maiden over from Ashleigh Gardner!
Ashleigh Gardner goes back to over the wicket. Delivers a fuller ball, outside off. Mithali Raj leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Mithali Raj shows the full face of her bat and blocks it out.
Ashleigh Gardner comes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller ball, on middle. Mithali Raj presses forward and defends it out.
Full again, on middle. Mithali Raj lunges and blocks it out.
Fuller, turning in, around off. Mithali Raj leans and defends it out.

Top shot but doesn't time it that well this time! An overpitched ball, outside off. Mithali Raj drives it past the cover fielder and the batters take three runs as the fielder at mid off cuts it off, just in front of the ropes.
On a length, around off. Mithali Raj keeps it out.
FOUR! That had class written all over it! Tossed up, full and outside off. Mithali Raj prods and carves it past the mid off fielder for a boundary. Trademark Mithali Raj!
Floated, full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia eases it to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Yastika Bhatia drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Yastika Bhatia stays back and punches it towards extra cover.
Tossed up, around off. Mithali Raj keeps it out.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle. Mithali Raj covers her off stump and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around middle. Mithali Raj gets forward and tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Deft touch! Clever from India's skipper! A quicker ball, on a length and outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back and guides it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Tosses it up, just outside off. Mithali Raj gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it.
Floated, around off. Mithali Raj defends it to the off side.
It will be spin from the other end as well! Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack.
A bit quicker this time from Jess, on a length, around middle. Mithali Raj looks to defend but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid-wicket for a run.
A loopy ball, well outside off. Mithali Raj prods and pushes it to mid off.
Floated, full and outside off. Mithali Raj keeps it out.
Full and on middle. Yastika Bhatia drills it to long on and takes a single.
Flatter ball, around leg. Mithali Raj tucks it to fine leg and rotates the strike.
Tossed up, around off. Mithali Raj gets forward and defends it.
Finally, Ellyse Perry completes her over! She comes over the wicket and serves it on a length, around off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Wide! Perry bowls it full but once again the line is too straight, it is down leg and it is another wide.
Wide! Full and down leg. Yastika Bhatia lets it be. Wided!

FIVE WIDES! Perry changes her angle, comes 'round the wicket but errs in line yet again. This is a full ball, angling down leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her flick. Alyssa Healy behind the sticks, fails to grab the ball and it races away to the fence.
Back of a length, outside off. Mithali Raj steers it towards third man and takes a single this time.
Much better from Perry! This is a good-length delivery, around the fifth stump channel. Mithali Raj offers no shot to that one.
Wide! Perry serves a full ball, shaping away well outside off. Raj leaves it alone and the umpire calls it wide.
Fuller in length, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Wide! Oh, dear! Another ball, down leg. Yastika Bhatia lets it be and the umpire stretches his arms yet again.
FOUR! Perry is clearly struggling with her line at the moment! She serves it around leg. Bhatia tickles it through fine leg and bags a boundary.
Wide! Another ball, this time well down leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her flick on the leg side and the umpire signals wide.
Perry begins with a full ball, around leg. Yastika Bhatia misses her flick and the ball brushes her pad before going through to the keeper.
Ellyse Perry comes into the attack now.

In the air....but safe! This is tossed up, around middle. Yastika Bhatia kneels to sweep but she gets a top edge which falls just in front of Ellyse Perry who runs in from fine leg. The batters take a run.
Slower through the air, around middle. Yastika Bhatia keeps it out.
A quicker ball, going on with the arm from middle. Mithali Raj tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Jess tosses it up, around off. Raj keeps it out.
Shorter in length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is darted on the pads. Yastika Bhatia clips it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
End of Powerplay 1! Australia Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over! Time for some spin as Jess Jonassen comes into the attack.
Length this time, wide of off. Mithali Raj leans but leaves it alone thinking it was a wide.
Back of a length, outside off. Mithali Raj stays in her crease and defends it out.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Mithali Raj lunges and leaves it alone.
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Mithali Raj defends it off the front foot.
On a length again, outside off. Mithali Raj pushes it towards point.
Edged...and away! On a length, wide of off. Yastika Bhatia prods and looks to drive, but the ball goes off the outside edge past the fielder at first slip. Single taken!
Fuller ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia works it away past mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Full, attacking the stumps. Yastika Bhatia pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Top shot! Megan Schutt serves it on a length, outside off, width on offer this time. Yastika Bhatia stays in her crease and slashes it past point for a cracking boundary.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Yastika Bhatia advances down the pitch and whips it towards mid on once again.
Very full, angling in, around middle. Yastika Bhatia knocks it to the fielder at mid on.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mithali Raj hangs back and leaves it alone.
Darcie Brown pitches it up once again, around middle and off. Mithali Raj drives and finds the fielder at cover this time.
Full on this occasion, on middle. Mithali Raj prods and drives it past cover for a brace.
Wide! Down the leg side this time, on a length. Mithali Raj looks to flick this but she misses. Wided!
Another length delivery, outside off. Mithali Raj offers no shot.
Darcie Brown serves this one a length, outside off. Mithali Raj leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mithali Raj pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Tad shorter now, outside off again. Mithali Raj pushes it towards third man for a single. She retains the strike!
On a length again, outside off. Mithali Raj dabs it towards cover-point.
Length ball, angling in, around the pads. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards fine leg and rotates the strike!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
A fuller ball now, around off. Yastika Bhatia punches it towards mid off. No run there!
On a length, angling in, on the pads. Yastika Bhatia looks to clip this one but she misses.
Mithali Raj walks in at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! India Women lose another wicket and Darcie Brown strikes yet again! India Women in trouble early on. Darcie Brown serves this one on a length, outside off. Shafali Verma stays in her crease, backs away, and opens the face of her bat, to guide it towards third man. But the ball goes off the splice and lobs up towards Beth Mooney, who leans towards her left and takes a sharp catch above her head at gully. Shafali Verma walks back early. Australia Women on top here!
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Shafali Verma drives it towards cover.
Darcie Brown drops it short now, around middle. Shafali Verma ducks underneath it.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Yastika Bhatia stays in her crease, pushes it towards cover and scampers through to the other end for a single.
On a length, wide of off now. Yastika Bhatia hangs back and cuts it to the fielder at point.
Swing and a miss A fuller ball, shaping away a tad, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans and looks to drive but she misses.

FOUR! Nicely done! Times it nicely this time and finds the gap to perfection! Back of a length, just outside off. Verma stays back, opens the bat face and guides it past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
SIX! BRUTE FORCE! This is Shafali Verma at her very best! A full ball, in the slot, around off. Verma prods and whacks it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
A loopy ball, outside off. Shafali Verma drives it to the extra cover fielder.
This is darted on the pads. Yastika Bhatia flicks it through mid-wicket and collects a run.
On a length, outside off. Verma stays back, opens the bat face and guides it past point for a single.
A full ball, on middle. Shafali Verma drives it nicely but straight to the mid on fielder.
Brown goes full again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia mistimes her drive towards the cover fielder. End of a successful over for Australia Women!
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards cover-point.
Wide! A short ball, down leg. Yastika Bhatia ducks underneath and the umpire calls it wide yet again.
Play and a miss! Brown bowls it full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but the ball beats her outside edge.
Wide! A wayward ball, well outside off. Yastika Bhatia lets it be and the umpire calls it wide.
Short of a length, around leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second run.
On a length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out.
Yastika Bhatia walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brown strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Smriti Mandhana! A wicket early on for Australia Women and the ploy of bringing on Brown for this match has done wonders for the Aussies! Brown serves it full, outside off, enticing the batter to drive. Smriti Mandhana looks for a booming drive without much feet movement. It takes the outside edge and the ball goes straight to Meg Lanning at first slip who does the rest. A huge blow for India Women as they lose their charismatic opening batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Meg Lanning b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Uppish but safe! Good-length ball, around off. Shafali Verma looks to drive on the up but it goes off the splice of her bat and lands just in front of the mid off fielder.
An overpitched ball, well outside off. Verma reaches out but fails to dig it out.
On a length, around off. Verma taps it towards backward point.
Aerial but safe! Back of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma throws her bat at it but it goes off the thick outside edge and falls short of the short third man fielder.
Fuller in length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana clips it off her pads towards fine leg and settles for a single.
Schutt hurls a full ball, angling across the batter. Smriti Mandhana prods and works it towards point.
Back of a length, around off. Shafali Verma gets right behind the line of the ball and defends it.
This is a length ball, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana nudges it behind square on the leg side and rotates the strike.
Good-length ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover. Not in the gap though!
FOUR! Easy pickings! First boundary of the innings! Brown errs in line and serves it around leg. Mandhana stays back and tickles it fine, through the fine leg region for a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Shafali Verma looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of her blade towards square leg for a run.
Brown starts with a length ball, around leg. Smriti Mandhana tucks it around the corner and hands the strike back to Verma!
Darcie Brown will bowl from the other end.
BEATEN! A full ball, angling in from outside off. Shafali Verma looks to free her arms through covers but the ball sneaks through her bat and pad. Tidy start from Megan Schutt!
A yorker-length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma squeezes it out towards point.
Fuller in length, yet again, outside off. Mandhana pushes it wide of mid off and gets to the other end.
Scutt bowls it full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives but finds the cover fielder.
Another ball, fuller in length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana digs it out to cover-point.
Schutt begins with a full ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana carves it through the cover region and takes a couple of runs. India Women are up and running!

We are done with the pre-match formalities and are ready for live action! The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will open the batting for India Women. Megan Schutt will begin with the ball. Here we go...
The match officials and both teams stride out for their respective national anthems. It will be Australia's national anthem first, followed by India's.

A special game for India's veteran, Jhulan Goswami as she is set to play her 200th ODI. India's skipper, Mithali Raj is presenting Goswami with her 200th ODI cap and she receives a round of applause from her teammates.

Shafali Verma is down for a chat. She says that they are in New Zealand for two months and they are used to the conditions and they know the grounds here. Mentions that she was also been working on her batting. Adds that she always believes in herself and she backs herself. Says that they are very excited about today's game.

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain is near the pitch. He says that the boundaries here are very short and talking about the pitch, he says that it is a new pitch and looks like a good one to bat on. Tells that the pitch looks flat and there won't be much for the spinners.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India Women, says that they would have bowled first as well, as the pitch looks fresh and it could help the fast bowlers early on. Informs that they have one change, Shafali Verma replaces Deepti Sharma. Adds that they have done well in this tournament, and now if they are playing against the best team, they need to bring their A-game forward.

Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women, says that they will bowl first. Tells that there are chances of rain later in the day so bowling first would be a good option. Says that they have made one change to their side and they are looking to get better every game. Mentions that India is a very dangerous side and they have a lot of depth.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma (In for Deepti Sharma), Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Rachael Haynes, Alyssa Healy (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Jess Jonassen, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown (In for Annabel Sutherland).
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

India Women on the flip side, have been a bit inconsistent so far as they have managed to win their alternate games in the competition. They are coming at the back of a disappointing batting performance in their previous game against England Women and they will need to bring their A-game against the Aussies. Mithali Raj would be hoping that her women will put on a show at the Eden Park and break Australia's winning streak. Will the Women in Blue get over the line against the mighty Aussies? Stay tuned as we find that soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Australia Women have been brilliant to say the least in this competition so far and they are sitting comfortable at the top of the points table, having won four games on the trot. They have been very clinical in their performances and the Aussies would be high on confidence heading into this game. Meg Lanning and her troops would be keen to stay unbeaten in the tournament and register their fifth consecutive win.

The race for a semi-final spot in the Women's World Cup, 2022 is heating up and game number 18 sees a clash between Australia Women and India Women which will commence in a short while at the iconic Eden Park in Auckland. On that note, a very warm welcome to the coverage of this mouth-watering clash between two cricketing giants.
